dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-grey patterns with diffuse edges transitioning to a dark base. The most prominent is a closed dorsal ring with a high-contrast boundary and a darker interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity pixels without internal gradients, primarily located in the central lateral field, forming a dense, non-geometric constellation.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationships defined by the centroids of three primary annuli in the upper mid-section forming a roughly equilateral configuration.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly reflective, segmented claw structures on the visible pectoral flipper, presenting as five distinct high-intensity points against a dark background.
